note: Whole-figure people: one image per person, outfit and pose drawn in one piece, cut out with Adobe background removal. Attributes per figure. Facing is the direction the body turns; the game mirrors to face the other way. Family: the same person painted at different ages shares one family id (family-066 pairs the teen boy in the gray hoodie with the young man in the gray hoodie, family-009 the teen girl with braids with the young woman with braids, chosen by skin, hair and clothes until the CTO paints true adult versions); every other look is its own family.
